thing-type.label: Wi-Fi Motor
thing-type.description: Blind, curtain or gate motor that is directly connected to Wi-Fi, controlled with the Connector or Motion Blinds app

parameter.name: macAddress
parameter.label: MAC Address
parameter.description: MAC address of the motor, as found by discovery (12 hex digits).

parameter.name: key
parameter.label: Key
parameter.description: 16 character key from the app, including dashes. In the Connector or Motion Blinds app go to Settings - About and tap the screen 5 times.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval for polling the status. The motor also pushes its status while moving and with a heartbeat about once a minute.

parameter.name: tiltTravel
parameter.label: Tilt Travel
parameter.description: Travel of the blind that turns the slats from closed on one side to closed on the other side. Increase it if tilt steps at mid-height turn the slats too far, decrease it if they do not turn far enough.

parameter.name: tiltSlack
parameter.label: Tilt Slack
parameter.description: Travel that does not turn the slats when the blind starts to move up from fully lowered, until the bottom rail lifts off. Increase it if tilt 50% from fully lowered turns the slats past open (bottom side visible), decrease it if they stay closed (top side visible).

channel-type.label: Position
channel-type.description: Position of the blind: 0% is fully open, 100% is fully closed

channel-type.label: Tilt
channel-type.description: Tilt of the slats at the current height: 0% is closed with the bottom side visible, 50% is open, 100% is closed with the top side visible

channel-type.label: Motor Angle
channel-type.description: Slat angle as estimated by the motor (0-180°). The estimate drifts from the real slats when the blind changes direction; use the tilt channel to control the slats.

channel-type.label: RSSI
channel-type.description: Wi-Fi signal strength of the motor
